user.title: Create an aligned cover group
user.description: Choose the shades to keep aligned. If a Lutron Pico is paired on the bridge to exactly these shades, choose its Up, Stop and Down buttons (enable the Pico's disabled button entities first) so the shades start and stop together.

shade.title: {name} ({index} of {count})
shade.description: Measure every shade's hemline (bottom edge) from the same reference point, such as inches from the floor.

travel.title: Travel time
travel.description: How long does {name}, the tallest shade, take to go from fully closed to fully open? All shades in the group are assumed to move at the same speed.

error.pico_incomplete: Choose all three Pico buttons, or none.
error.closed_not_below_open: The closed height must be below the open height.
error.cover_unsupported: Every shade must support setting a position and stopping.
error.pico_duplicate: Choose a different button for each Pico role.
error.ranges_do_not_overlap: This shade's open-to-closed range doesn't overlap the other shades'. Every shade's range must share some height.
